newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers pushed up, Mediterranean stable.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers pushed up, Mediterranean stable.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers gained about $2 a tonne on Friday as the barge market took off, while prices in southern Europe were stable, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at $87/$88 fob as barge offers reached $87 ex wharf.
The rise in prices and the lack of many players left buying reasonably poor except for a couple of larger enquiries which one trading house supplied.
Some buyers were more eager to postpone enquiries, believing they would see cheaper offers on Monday with all would-be sellers back at work.
Hamburg bunkers also rose in response to Rotterdam gains. Fuel oil was quoted about $2 a tonne higher than on Thursday at $92/$93 fob.

Mediterranean prices were broadly unchanged. Business was slack despite a sense that prices would rise early next week to follow gains in northern Europe. The Egyptian market was quiet despite prices on a par with Rotterdam.
Higher-priced Fujairah bunkers meanwhile were much in demand, at least in the morning, trading at $96/$97 delivered.
